factsheet_lines_1_indexed.12: 1. Eustace Grint's Burn-Out (Early 1902) - Grint faces mental exhaustion from the demands of lighthouse keeping.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.13: 2. Creation of the Mural (Summer 1902) - Grint paints a vibrant mural on the lighthouse.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.14: 3. Community Division (Late 1902) - The mural causes a rift in the community between traditionalists and modernists.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.15: 4. Surge in Coastal Tourism (Late 1902) - The mural attracts artists and tourists from afar.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.16: 5. Inception of the Windwhistle Coastal Art Festival (1903) - Inspired by the mural's success, a festival is established to celebrate coastal art.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.17: 6. Cementing of the Lighthouse in Art History (Post-1903) - The lighthouse becomes a symbol and landmark in art and maritime culture.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.21: 1. Windwhistle Cliffs - The rugged coastline where the lighthouse is situated.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.22: 2. Windwhistle Lighthouse - The site of Grint's mural and a symbol of creative liberation.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.23: 3. Nearby Coastal Villages - Communities affected by the increase in tourism.

factsheet_lines_1_indexed.29: 2. Summer 1902 - When Grint painted the mural.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.30: 3. Late 1902 - Time of community division and increased tourism.

factsheet_lines_1_indexed.36: 1. Grint's Mental State - Burn-out led him to seek an outlet for his frustration through art.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.37: 2. Artistic Impulse - Grint's impulsiveness resulted in a departure from tradition, sparking debate.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.38: 3. Community Dynamics - The mural challenged conventional aesthetic values, causing division.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.39: 4. Cultural Shift - The incident marked a shift towards embracing creative expression and modern art.

The unit may then stay in its group. (b) Otherwise give the unit its own group: a new id ground-<event>-<nn> with an unused nn, source_unit_ids [the unit], statement = source_statement verbatim, and a grouping_rationale.
